newsitem.title: USA: Tower Automotive completes stock offer.
newsitem.headline: Tower Automotive completes stock offer.

text.p: Tower Automotive Inc said Tuesday it completed an offer of 8.5 million common shares for $35 each.

Proceeds will be used to finance a portion of the acquisition of the Automotive Products division of A.O. Smith Corp, Tower said. The company said certain stockholders also sold about 1.6 million common shares as part of the offer.
Tower makes a range of stamped and welded assemblies for vehicle body structures used by automobile manufacturers.
Its shares closed unchanged Tuesday at 35.
